name: Exp_AroonHornSign
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AroonHornSign indicator, opening buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop-loss/take-profit, and separate toggles for opening and closing positions on each signal direction. The strategy also performs a historical bar scan to detect close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AroonHornSign指标信号进行交易，在上涨动量信号时开多仓，在下跌动量信号时开空仓。支持多种资金管理模式、止损止盈设置，以及分别控制买卖方向的开关和平仓开关。当同时启用开仓和平仓时，还会扫描历史K线寻找平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于Aroon指标衍生出的AroonHornSign自定义指标，捕捉价格动量方向变化产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区(索引1)在指定信号Bar上出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时触发买入信号，下轨缓冲区(索引0)出现类似值时触发卖出信号。出场条件分为两部分：信号本身可直接触发反向平仓（如上涨信号触发卖出平仓），同时当买卖开仓和平仓均启用时，EA会向后扫描历史K线寻找更早的反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持按余额百分比、可用保证金百分比、损失后余额/保证金百分比或固定手数五种模式。止损和止盈以点数设置，默认值较大（止损1000点，止盈2000点），表明策略追求较大的趋势行情。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the AroonHornSign custom indicator derived from the Aroon indicator, capturing trading signals from price momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's upper buffer (index 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified signal bar, and a sell signal triggers similarly on the lower buffer (index 0). Exit conditions operate in two parts: the signal itself can directly trigger reverse-side position closure (e.g., an up signal triggers sell-side closure), and when both open and close permissions are enabled for buy and sell sides, the EA scans historical bars backward to find earlier opposing signals as close confirmation. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting five modes: percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, percentage after loss on balance/margin, or fixed lot size. Stop-loss and take-profit are set in points with large default values (SL=1000, TP=2000), indicating the strategy targets larger trend movements. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing repeated trades on the same bar.

parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（固定手数/按余额/按可用保证金等）
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平空仓）
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平多仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 使用Aroon动量指标捕捉趋势方向变化，逻辑清晰直观
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持固定手数和多种按比例计算方式
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，适应不同交易场景需求
采用IsNewBar机制限制每根K线只计算一次信号，避免信号重复触发
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Uses the Aroon momentum indicator to capture trend direction changes with clear and intuitive logic
Provides flexible money management modes supporting fixed lots and multiple proportional calculation methods
Buy and sell side open/close controls are independently configurable, adapting to different trading scenarios
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to limit signal calculation to once per bar, preventing duplicate signal triggers
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 历史K线扫描平仓逻辑存在性能隐患，当Bars数量很大时可能遍历大量K线
min_rates_total计算逻辑有bug，第68行直接用3+SignalBar覆盖了第67行的MathMax计算
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在不利条件下可能成交
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
指标句柄失败时仅打印俄文错误信息，不利于国际化调试
cons_en: The historical bar scanning exit logic has performance concerns, potentially iterating over a very large number of bars when Bars count is high
The min_rates_total calculation has a bug: line 68 overwrites the MathMax result from line 67 with 3+SignalBar, rendering the ATR/Aroon period check useless
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially executing trades under unfavorable conditions
No position check logic exists, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction when one already exists
Indicator handle failure only prints Russian error messages, hindering international debugging
improvements: 为历史K线扫描添加最大搜索范围限制，避免遍历过多K线导致性能问题
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，提升实盘交易质量
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
improvements_en: Fix the min_rates_total calculation bug by taking MathMax of MathMax(AroonPeriod,ATR_Period) and 3+SignalBar
Add a maximum search range limit to the historical bar scan to prevent excessive iteration and performance issues
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve live trading quality
Add position check logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction

risk_points: min_rates_total计算bug可能导致指标数据不足时仍执行交易逻辑
缺少持仓检查可能造成同方向重复开仓，放大风险敞口
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点差距较大，单笔亏损可能显著
risk_points_en: The min_rates_total calculation bug may allow trading logic to execute even when indicator data is insufficient
Lack of position checking may cause duplicate entries in the same direction, amplifying risk exposure
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points with a large gap means single-trade losses can be significant

The strategy also performs a historical bar scan to detect close signals when both open and close permissions are enabled.
